changelog: v1.0.2 — Added README.md with overview, features, dependencies, installation, and credits. Standardized GitHub repo metadata (badges, dynamic version pull, MIT license, Qbox required). v1.0.1 — Removed Employment service. Players now get jobs at actual work locations instead of City Hall. Stripped the Employment tab, jobsGrid, selectJob client/server callbacks, Config.Jobs, BuildJobs/FindJob/SetPlayerJob helpers, and the Employment Record entry from Records. The header still displays the player's current job as informational status only. v1.0.0 — Initial release.
